name: Supply Chain, Inventory & Warehouse Management Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Supply Chain, Inventory and Warehouse Management (WMS), covering demand forecasting, reorder point planning, stock receiving, put-away, bin management, picking/packing, cycle counting, inventory valuation (FIFO/LIFO/AVCO), and transportation planning.
owner: Global Supply Chain & WMS Operations Office

checklists.name: Supply Chain & WMS Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for demand planning, dock receiving, bin tracking, wave picking, and cycle count reconciliation.

items.statement: Safety stock and reorder points (ROP) dynamically adjust based on seasonal demand trends and lead times.
Dock receiving inspects incoming shipments against PO delivery notes before generating GRNs.
Directed put-away assigns items to designated warehouse bin locations based on SKU velocity and dimensions.
Wave picking and packing processes scan barcodes at item level to prevent shipping errors.
Periodic cycle counting verifies physical stock against system balance with manager sign-off for variances.

reviewGates.name: Supply Chain Operations Director Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Supply Chain Director confirms that inventory valuation, WMS bin accuracy, and order dispatch workflows satisfy operational benchmarks.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the supply chain documentation confirm inventory accuracy and WMS fulfillment performance?
